desc: The M4-22 PRO Compact Pistol is a premium .22 caliber semi-automatic AR styled pistol with aluminum upper and lower receivers and all the features of a true M4 pistol. The PRO Pistol features a 11 inch barrel, 9 inch Composite MLok handguard, Compact Bolt System, Rear Pic Rail Adapter and weighs only 4.1 lbs.
